blocking_condition: Requires scattering-normalized coefficient and common incident phase gauge; neither is established.
medium_branch: kz=sqrt((n*k0)^2-kx^2), passive branch Re(kz)>=0 and Im(kz)>=0
open_order_rule: real propagating orders only; evanescent orders excluded from power
power_invariance: |a|^2 invariant in homogeneous lossless medium for propagating order under phase-only transform
reflection_transform: a_R(z=0-) = a_R(z=-300) * exp(-i*kz_sio2*(0-(-300) nm)) for backward wave
